description:
In Episode 244 we discuss how the Bible accurately predicted, through the prophecies, that the final messages to the world would be given by a small remnant that keeps the Commandments and have the testimony of Jesus, which is the Spirit of Prophecy. There is only one denomination which qualifies according to all the biblical criteria, and the Bible also prophesied that this remnant church will be shaken to purge it. Are we at that point in time?
